facts.title: Learn Enchanting
facts.note: No skill or level needed; teaches to skill 75. Disenchant is in the Enchanting box of the Professions window, not the spellbook.

facts.title: Journeyman Enchanting
facts.note: Needs Enchanting 50 and level 10; teaches to 150.

facts.title: Enchanting 1-70: Runed Copper Rod, then bracers
facts.note: 1-2: Runed Copper Rod (Copper Rod and Mote of Magic, both from the Enchanting Supply vendor, not the Auction House). 2-20: 18 Enchant Bracer - Inferior Stamina (a Mote of Magic each). 20-70: 50 Enchant Bracer - Minor Deflect (Lesser Magic Essence) or 50 Enchant Chest - Inferior Stamina (Strange Dust). Forever's new low recipes make these points cheaper than in Classic.

facts.title: Enchanting 70-150: chest and weapon enchants
facts.note: With essences: 70-109 Enchant Chest - Minor Absorption; 110-150 Enchant 2H Weapon - Lesser Intellect (formula from Kithas in Orgrimmar or Tilli Thistlefuzz in Ironforge). With dust: 70-100 Enchant Bracer - Minor Stamina; 100-130 Enchant Cloak - Minor Protection; 130-150 Enchant Boots - Minor Stamina. 109-110 either way: Runed Silver Rod (a Blacksmith's Silver Rod and a Shadowgem).

facts.title: Expert Enchanting
facts.note: Needs Enchanting 125 and level 20; teaches to 225.
